CustomField.description: Checks user role/profile and permissions to create checklist
CustomField.formula:
IF( AND( $Permission.Checklist_Create_Sold_To_Paid, Number_of_STP_Checklists__c = 0, OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Proposal"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closing")), OR( ISPICKVAL(NSP_PrimaryProduct__c,"WX"), ISPICKVAL(NSP_PrimaryProduct__c,"WO"), ISPICKVAL(NSP_PrimaryProduct__c,"WS"), ISPICKVAL(NSP_PrimaryProduct__c,"HRScale"))),"STP",
IF( AND( $Permission.Checklist_Create_MidMarket_Closing, Number_of_MMC_Checklists__c = 0, OR(ISPICKVAL( Account.NSP_Account_Segment__c, "MidMarket"), ISPICKVAL( Account.NSP_Account_Segment__c, "Enterprise")), OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Analysis"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Proposal"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closing")), OR( ISPICKVAL(NSP_PrimaryProduct__c,"WX"), ISPICKVAL(NSP_PrimaryProduct__c,"WO"), ISPICKVAL(NSP_PrimaryProduct__c,"WS"))),"MMC",null))
CustomField.label: Checklist User Check Formula
